name: Wren
about:
Wren is a small journal for a few lines a day: quick to open, quiet to use, and kind about the days you miss.

The mark is a wren, the smallest bird with the loudest song, drawn entirely from arcs of one set of circles so it stays round, calm and even at any size.
construction: Every curve is an arc of a circle from one Fibonacci set (8, 16, 24, 40, 64, 104 on a 256 grid): body 64, head 40, a tail lens of two 64s, a beak lens of two 40s, an eye of 8, and a wing crescent between a 64 and a 104. The red circles are the grid.
